一块废弃充电电池，不应该留在海滩上。: A discarded rechargeable battery does not belong on the beach.

为什么要减少一次性塑料制品？: Why should we use fewer single-use plastic items?
因为它们可能进入海洋，影响动物与环境: They may enter the ocean and harm wildlife and habitats
减少一次性塑料的使用，有助于从源头减少进入环境的塑料垃圾。: Using fewer single-use plastics helps prevent litter before it enters the environment.
在海边发现破损电池，应该怎么做？: What should you do if you find a damaged battery on the beach?
徒手捡起放进口袋: Pick it up with bare hands and put it in your pocket
告诉成年人，按当地要求安全处理: Tell an adult so it can be handled safely under local rules
